Start: Brallin, Skyshark Rider (battlefield); Change of Fortune (hand); Swarm Intelligence (battlefield); Grafted Exoskeleton (battlefield)
Prerequisites: Grafted Exoskeleton attached to Brallin.
  You have at least six cards in hand.
Steps: Cast Change of Fortune by paying {3}{R}.
  Swarm Intelligence triggers, creating a copy of Change of Fortune.
  Resolve the copy of Change of Fortune, discarding your hand and drawing cards equal to the number of cards you've discarded this turn.
  Brallin triggers for each card discarded, putting that many +1/+1 counters on itself and giving each opponent that many poison counters.
  Resolve the original Change of Fortune, discarding your hand and drawing cards equal to the number of cards you've discarded this turn.
  Brallin triggers for each card discarded, putting that many +1/+1 counters on itself and giving each opponent that many poison counters.
  Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

Color identity: UR | Bracket: Exhibition | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {1}
Produces: Infinite combat phases; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite mana creatures you control can produce; Infinite untap of creatures you control; Put all Equipment cards from your library onto the battlefield
Start: Phantom Steed (battlefield); Godo, Bandit Warlord (battlefield); Wormfang Drake (exile: exiled by Phantom Steed); Unnatural Selection (battlefield); Smellerbee, Rebel Fighter (battlefield)
Steps: Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Phantom Steed to become a Samurai until end of turn.
  Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
  Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping it and all Samurai you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
  Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
  When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
  At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
  When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
  When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.
